    1. saveRssFeed(List, File)

Interface RssFeedFileGenerator

All Superinterfaces:
FileGenerator
public interface RssFeedFileGenerator extends FileGenerator
API to save an RSS File into an output directory. The RSS feed will be generated based on a list of guides. To generate the RSS Feed RssFeedGenerator can be used.
